name: clone-prototype
title_zh: 像素级克隆真实 App 界面
tagline_zh: 对着截图一比一复刻界面，不用猜尺寸和颜色——自动叠网格、取色、生成设计令牌，每个屏幕一个 HTML 文件。
tagline_en: Recreate any app screen pixel-perfectly without guessing—auto grid, color sampling, design tokens, one HTML per.
desc_en: Clone a real app's screens as pixel-accurate, self-contained HTML artboards on the prototype canvas. Overlay a grid on the reference and sample colours visually, derive one measured design-token block, generate one HTML file per screen from a single script, verify by re-rendering, and park the reference underneath its mockup. Use when asked to 100% copy / clone an app's UI, rebuild screens from sc
why_zh: 把视觉还原变成可验证的流程：量测令牌、脚本生成、重渲染比对，杜绝手抖和眼瞎，克隆结果经得起逐像素检查。
why_en: Turns visual cloning into a verifiable pipeline—measured tokens, scripted output, re-render check—so every pixel is accounted.
limit_zh: 只认静态界面截图，不处理交互动效、响应式布局或真实数据绑定；产物是 HTML 画板，不是可运行的前端工程。
limit_en: Only static screen images; no interactions, responsive layouts, or live data. Output is HTML artboard, not a runnable app.
title_en: Clone real app screens as pixel-accurate HTML artboards
